text:
maria_pm: quick follow-up from the enterprise call — ACME wants tenant-scoped logs + SCIM SSO before pilot. they asked for a 'no-go' unless both are in the pilot. asking for next-month pilot window.

sam_eng: yikes. SSO + per-tenant audit increases work by a lot. rough estimate: SSO + SCIM connectors = 2 sprints, tenant audit pipeline + retention = 1-2 sprints depending on compliance needs.

devon_platform: infra POV: we can ship a limited audit view in the console (read-only, sampled events) in 1 sprint as an interim. full ingestion to customer SIEM/HSM integrations is more work. KMS/HSM knobs will be a separate compliance ticket.

tara_sales: ACME pushed hard because security needs legal sign-off. they might accept a pilot if we commit to roadmap dates and a clear fallbacks list.

alex_head_product: high-level ask: decide whether MVP includes both SSO+tenant-logs or we do a pilot-limited "security-lite" SKU (hosted-only, sampled logs + SSO). if we push both into MVP it shifts the launch window out.

maria_pm: proposal: two launch lanes — "fast lane" (hosted-only, sampled audit, SSO basic) for early customers; "full lane" (dedicated + full audit + SIEM/KMS) for enterprise GA. we communicate clear criteria to sales.

sam_eng: agree on lanes. non-blocking to fast lane: we need SSO, session revocation, and sampled audit surface. don't include SIEM forwarding.

devon_platform: can implement sampled audit + console slicer in 1 sprint. I'll draft the minimal schema and retention rules.

maria_pm: can we call that MVP-min? and v1 = full-lane in Q2? need coms to ACME today.

tara_sales: yes, ACME prefers guaranteed dates. if we offer fast lane pilot next month and commit to full-lane GA in Q2, they sign pilot.

alex_head_product: ok decision: ship fast lane as MVP (hosted-only, basic SSO, sampled tenant logs + audit view). defer SIEM/HSM/KMS integrations to v1. add rollout policy: canary with 5 tenants -> 20 -> full.

maria_pm: action items: @sam_eng break down tasks into two lists (MVP-min / v1-full). @devon_platform prepare console mock + sampled audit schema. @tara_sales communicate lane plan + dates to ACME. I'll update roadmap and the milestone board.

sam_eng: will post the task split by EOD.

devon_platform: mock + schema by tomorrow noon.

tara_sales: i'll run the comms and get ACME sign-off by EOD tomorrow.

release-bot: Deploy plan template created: ``\ncanary: 5 tenants\nscale-step-1: 20 tenants\nscale-step-2: full rollout\nrollout-guards: error-rate < 1%, latency SLA met\n``

maria_pm: thanks all. quick follow-up tomorrow: if any of the task estimates blow out, we escalate to leadership before committing dates.

sam_eng: noted. will flag any risks in the task doc.

devon_platform: adding a risk: audit retention >90 days may need infra ops storage budget — will call out.

maria_pm: perfect. closing thread, updating milestone tracker now. :white_check_mark:
